notes.title: Another Status Update!
notes.notes:
Hey all, well I'll be upfront about what's the most important part of this update; we're planning a Mid-2019 release instead. Me and the other developer have had a busy life and were not able to dedicate enough time towards this game for an Early 2019 launch. It's unfortunate, but there was no other way with our schedules. With that being said...

We are officially looking for Game Testers who want to try out our game! We're reaching a point where we may begin releasing test copies through the Steam platform, and we'd love more feedback! If you're interested, please don't hesitate to let us know! Previous game testing experience is preferred.

Thanks for continuing to stick with us, and we heavily apologize for these delays. We'll be trying harder than ever to release the finished product whenever it's ready to go!

(And thanks to smjjames for letting me know to post this! I completely forgot to and apologize for waiting this long to post it.)

notes.title: Quick Status Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I know I've barely posted much here, but I'd like to give a little status update before we set into the new year.

Obviously, we won't be releasing Tano's Fate in 2018 like originally planned. This is because of how this game has somewhat conflicted with our life schedule, and as a result we couldn't work on the game enough in time to give it a proper release this year. We definitely plan to have a release in Early 2019 instead.

Rest assured that we have given the game good progress into development and hope to have another look at the game to show you in the near future.

To make up for this delay, we are officially announcing to have an official video on what we've implemented into the game so far, along with short weekly status updates on some of the things you can do in the game itself!

We apologize for this delay and hope that this as a result makes the game as good as it could possibly be! Stay tuned for more information!
